Carousel

A set of slides shown one (or a few) at a time with previous/next controls, a slide picker, and optional auto-rotation that pauses the moment anyone touches it — the APG carousel with the accessibility built in rather than bolted on.

Basic usage

Install the package:

pnpm add @design-schema/react

Import the stylesheet once for the app, then the component:

import '@design-schema/react/index.css';
import { Carousel } from '@design-schema/react';

Examples

Aria desk lamp

A dimmable lamp with a warm-to-cool range.

Solstice mug

Double-walled ceramic that holds its heat for hours.

Range planter

Self-watering, fits a windowsill.
import { Carousel, CarouselSlide, Card } from '@design-schema/react';

<Carousel label="Featured products">
  <>
    <CarouselSlide label="Aria desk lamp">
      <Card heading="Aria desk lamp">A dimmable lamp with a warm-to-cool range.</Card>
    </CarouselSlide>
    <CarouselSlide label="Solstice mug">
      <Card heading="Solstice mug">Double-walled ceramic that holds its heat for hours.</Card>
    </CarouselSlide>
    <CarouselSlide label="Range planter">
      <Card heading="Range planter">Self-watering, fits a windowsill.</Card>
    </CarouselSlide>
  </>
</Carousel>

Props

PropTypeDefaultDescriptionPlatforms
label requiredstring—

What the carousel shows ("Featured products", "Customer stories").

Accessibility: aria-label on the region; each slide is named "{n} of {total}" plus its own heading.

web, lit, rn, swiftui
children requiredcontent—

One `CarouselSlide` per slide. A slide is any content; a Card is the usual shape. Slides should be equal height.

web, lit, rn, swiftui
perViewnumber1

How many slides are visible at once at the widest layout; fewer are shown as the viewport narrows (one below the prose width).

web, lit, rn, swiftui
loopbooleanfalse

Next from the last returns to the first. Off by default so users can tell where the end is.

web, lit, rn, swiftui
autoplaybooleanfalse

Rotate automatically every `interval`. Starts only when the user has not asked for reduced motion; stops on hover, focus, touch, or the play/pause button; never restarts on its own after the user pauses it.

web, lit, rn, swiftui
intervalnumber6000

Milliseconds between automatic advances; values below 5000 are raised to 5000 on every platform (with a development warning).

web, lit, rn, swiftui
pickerdots | tabs | nonedots

How slides are chosen directly: small dot buttons, tabs with each slide's label (for few, meaningful slides), or none (arrows only).

web, lit, rn, swiftui
activeIndexnumber—

Controlled current slide (zero-based). Omit for uncontrolled.

web, lit, rn, swiftui
snapbooleantrue

Swiping or scrolling snaps to slide boundaries.

web, lit, rn, swiftui

Accessibility

Decisions this component leaves to you

Supply an accessible name. This component has no text of its own to fall back on, so without one a screen reader announces its role and nothing else.

If you wire up the gesture events, provide the pointer and keyboard path to the same outcome.

Required props that carry accessibility meaning: label. Each is described in the props table above.

Implicit ARIA role: region.

Anatomy

regionviewporttrackslidecontrolSurfaceprevButtonnextButtonpickerpickerItemplayButtonliveRegion

What generation guarantees

Accessible name — Every instance carries a programmatic name. Where the component has no text of its own to use, the name is a prop the consumer supplies.

Keyboard operable — Everything the pointer can do here, the keyboard can do — see the keyboard section.

Arrow navigation — Arrow keys move between items; Home and End jump to the ends.

Visible focus — Keyboard focus is always drawn, from the theme’s focus tokens, and is never removed.

Contrast — Text and meaningful non-text contrast meets WCAG AA; the pairs are listed below.

Target size — Interactive targets are at least 24×24 CSS pixels (WCAG 2.2 Target Size, minimum).

Reduced motion — Under `prefers-reduced-motion: reduce` the transitions are dropped rather than shortened, and the component still reaches every state.

Live region — Changes are announced through a live region, without moving focus.

Gesture alternative — Every gesture — swipe, drag, long-press — has a single-pointer and a keyboard equivalent.

No hover-only content — Nothing is reachable by hover alone; keyboard focus reveals the same content.

Selected state — Selection is exposed programmatically (`aria-selected` / `aria-checked`).

Carousel keyboard support

KeyAction
TabMoves through the controls (play/pause, previous, next, picker) and then into the current slide's focusable content; hidden slides are inert.
ArrowRightNext slide. (focus on picker or in a tabs picker)
ArrowLeftPrevious slide. (focus on picker)
HomeFirst slide. (focus on picker)
EndLast slide. (focus on picker)
Enter or SpaceActivates the focused control: previous, next, a picker item, or play/pause.
